messages:
Alex R.: Morning — quick async checkin. What I did: finished the audit iterator for S3 key listing and pushed PR #482 (https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/482). Blockers: KMS rotation dry-run failing in staging with AccessDenied on the rotator service account. Today: triage perms, run dry-run again, and get rotation green by EOD. @Jordan P. can you review PR when you have a moment?

Jordan P.: on it, will take a look in ~30m. saw the staging job fail too, likely IAM role missing on the SA. leaving a note on the CI logs.

Maria T.: moved SEC-314 -> in_progress and added initial findings. I can check the KMS IAM policy. Quick tip: run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy redwood-rotator --location=global --keyring=prod` or inspect `terraform state show module.kms.google_kms_crypto_key.redwood`. Most likely the service account needs `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`.

Sam W.: earlier I rolled back the canary to avoid noisy errors, deployment looks stable. If rotation is blocked we can postpone the automated run and do a manual rotation later today. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Automated scan result: vuln-scan v2 detected 3 findings in package `jsonwebtoken` in image infra/service:2.1.7. Issue created: SEC-319 (https://tracker.redwood/security/SEC-319).

Alex R.: thanks — I'll pick up SEC-319 after rotation. @Maria T. can you confirm the rotator SA needs both encrypter role and token-impersonation? I'll prep an infra PR once confirmed. :coffee:

Jordan P.: quick CR note for #482: add a unit test that mocks KMS decrypt behavior (small mock only). also left a tiny nit about error wrapping.

Maria T.: confirmed: service account `redwood-kms-rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` needs `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` for running as the rotator. Adding runbook checklist to SEC-314. Runbook snippet: 

```
# dry-run rotation
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=redwood-rotator --location=global --keyring=prod
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=redwood-rotator --location=global --keyring=prod
# verify service account can decrypt
gcloud kms keys encrypt --plaintext-file=./sample.txt --ciphertext-file=./ct --location=global --keyring=prod --key=redwood-rotator --project=redwood-prod
```

Alex R.: perfect, thanks Maria. I'll update the PR and open an infra PR to grant the roles, then re-run the dry-run and ping infra. Wrapping up this update, will post results here.
